sources.description: The U.S. Department of Justice has reportedly opened an investigation into the NFL and whether the league has “engaged in anticompetitive tactics that harm consumers,” according to the Wall Street Journal. The news broke on Thursday morning. The NFL and DOJ both declined to comment to the WSJ. The newspaper suggests the investigation likely centers […]
